snippet.title: Zelda: The Legend of Morrowind - OoT x Morrowind Crossover Mod (Full Game)
snippet.description:
Romhack by Sunset Tides Interactive (Trevor Belmondo, @CorrMods , @woon6436, E-Gor, KoloKorn) with help from Chadlight
Released on 1/17/26 for the Hylian Modding 2025 Crossover Competition.
Download: https://hylianmodding.com/competition-2025
*The hack is listed as "The Legend of the Wind" on the Hylian Modding download page.
Recorded on Project 64 3.0.1

From the team that made last competition's Curse of the Moonlight comes an incredible adventure mod.
There are a total of 7 quests to complete and 21 Heart Containers to find (As of 1.0 release)
